name: China Tourism And Culture Investment Group Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: China Tourism & Culture Investment Group Co., Ltd. (CTCIG) specializes in the investment, growth, and management of a diverse portfolio of ventures. Its core operations encompass marine leisure and water sports tourism, alongside the planning and construction of dedicated sports and entertainment townships. Further expanding its reach, CTCIG engages in youth athletic training, the trade of sports equipment and apparel, internet marketing services, and the integrated marketing of commercial real estate intellectual property. The company structures its extensive activities into four primary business segments. The Sports division includes areas like e-sports, athletic events and exhibitions, and water sailing instruction. Its Cultural Entertainment arm delivers stage performances and orchestrates global tours, often centered on historical themes. The Leisure Travel segment focuses on providing outdoor tourism experiences, while the Club Membership offerings grant access to exclusive theme clubs, hot springs, and personalized holiday packages. Founded on December 29, 1998, CTCIG maintains its corporate headquarters in Nanjing, China.
